# `fara_filings`

**FARA filing evidence**

One historical filing metadata observation, with selected original PDF hashes and explicitly limited principal-label associations.

**Coverage.** Sampled by design. Every record for the explicitly selected native registration numbers in each pinned production bulk export is retained, including historical filings and terminated relationships. Capture descriptors define the observed snapshot; separate exports are not an atomic publisher release. Principal entity IDs are not supplied. Exact label associations do not establish identity or documentary agreement. Linked documents outside the explicit selection remain unfetched; document review notes preserve differences. This is bounded local qualification, not evidence of public delivery or publisher-wide historical completeness. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `fara_filings.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `registration_number` | `VARCHAR` | Native registration number preserved as text, including leading zeros. Repeated registrations remain separate observations. |
| `document_id` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher PDF filename from the source-stated production URL, retained without rewriting. |
| `document_url` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated production PDF URL, validated against its native registration number. |
| `document_type` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher filing type. No document content is extracted into structured activity or financial facts. |
| `stamped_date` | `DATE` | Parsed publisher Date Stamped; source text remains in raw_fields_json. |
| `date_diagnostic` | `VARCHAR` | Stamped-date parse status: value, absent, blank or unparsed. |
| `date_after_capture` | `BOOLEAN` | True when the literal stamped date is later than the capture date. The publisher date is retained and flagged, not guessed or corrected. |
| `principal_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal foreign-principal label supplied by the selected export. Labels do not establish entity equivalence. |
| `principal_country` | `VARCHAR` | Literal filing-export principal country; null/empty is distinct from a match. |
| `foreign_principal_observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Relationship observation matched only by exact registration number, principal label and country within the selected export. Null for absent, unmatched or ambiguous labels. |
| `association_status` | `VARCHAR` | export_label_unique, registrant_only, ambiguous_label or unresolved_label. A unique export-label match is not a document-verified entity identity. |
| `principal_candidates_json` | `VARCHAR` | All exact export-label candidate observation IDs. Duplicate labels remain ambiguous. |
| `document_status` | `VARCHAR` | retained for a selected hash-checked original, otherwise not_selected. An advertised link does not prove downloaded bytes. |
| `document_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original PDF, null for metadata-only filings. |
| `document_bytes` | `BIGINT` | Retained original PDF byte size, null when not selected. |
| `document_review_status` | `VARCHAR` | Bounded human visual finding: supports_registration_and_principal_label, principal_label_differs, unreviewed or not_selected. Read the finding and sample limits before interpreting an association. |
| `document_review_json` | `VARCHAR` | Bounded review note, original digest, page and viewed-image digest. A label difference remains explicit without replacing publisher metadata. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Export kind, exact original digest and row ordinal. Identifies an observation, not an inferred entity. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact admitted SpicyDocs source-release digest. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original URL, digest, capture time, ZIP member digest and original XML XPath or CSV line coordinates. Encoding corrections are explicit. |
| `raw_fields_json` | `VARCHAR` | Literal native field names and values. Absent XML fields stay absent; empty elements stay empty strings; unknown fields survive. |
